.²5 An elephant.

 {#maSako yaTAviSat#} <ls>Bhāg. 12. 9. 27</ls>.
.²8 <ab>N.</ab> of an eastern country; {#brahmottarA pravijayA BArgavAjYeyamallakAH#} <ls>Mārk. P.</ls>
.²9 An astrologer, fortune-teller; {#‘BArgavo SukradEvajYO’#} <ls>Vaijayantī</ls>;
